topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of ethics and conflict of interest policy acknowledged each year by all staff and directors; sanctions procedure in POL-01 4.7
Board approves the program and receives the annual report; Audit and Risk Committee oversees security quarterly; no board-approved risk appetite yet
ISO designated by board resolution; POL-01 sets reporting lines; ISO also runs IT and reports to the COO
remediation: Direct ISO reporting line to the Audit and Risk Committee; evaluate independent ISO in 2027 budget

control_description: Background checks before hire; annual awareness training; no role-based fraud training
gap: No BEC or wire-fraud training for branch and wire staff

control_description: Policies assign accountability; policy acknowledgments collected at hire; 2026 acknowledgments of POL-01 to POL-05 not yet complete
gap: Acknowledgments of the new policies outstanding

control_description: Device inventory complete; provider and bank logs generated but not reviewed, so security information is not used
remediation: Daily change report and monthly core review

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies approved 2026-08-27; 8 of 12 branch staff interviewed did not know how to report an incident
gap: Incident reporting not understood at branches

control_description: Treasury management agreements set the security procedure with business customers; no designated incident contacts given to bank service providers

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives set in POL-01 and the SSP; risk tolerances drafted but not board-approved
2026 risk register per SP 800-30 Rev. 1 with 32 risks tied to systems and processes
Risk register covers BEC, account takeover, and insider wire fraud; BSA program monitors fraud
evidence: P01 R-001 R-002 R-019; BSA procedures

control_description: Change triggers now in POL-01 4.11; the AI credit model pilot started without a risk assessment
gap: Significant changes not assessed before go-live
remediation: Apply POL-01 4.11 triggers; AI model review before expansion (P10)

control_description: Annual IT audit, annual penetration test, and 2026 control assessment; no ongoing monitoring metrics; provider SOC reports not evaluated until 2026
evidence: P07; IT audit report; penetration test report
gap: No ongoing monitoring; provider reviews incomplete
remediation: Monthly metrics to the COO; remaining provider SOC reviews

control_description: Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M with owners and dates and reported quarterly to the Audit and Risk Committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected in the SSP for the WDBP; 35 of 62 not fully implemented
General IT controls in place for endpoints; admin console and cloud configuration not baselined
gap: No configuration baseline for WDBP settings or the cloud tenant

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Five policies approved; branch procedures for wires, access, and incident reporting not written

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Workforce SSO and MFA; isolated payments segment; customer MFA optional; teller and back office on one flat network
evidence: IdP configuration; admin console settings; P04
gap: Password-only business users can add beneficiaries

control_description: Manager-approved onboarding through HR tickets; termination notices do not reach the core administrator
Role-based access in the wire platform and admin console; no quarterly core reviews; 4 stale core accounts; approvers can edit templates
gap: Access reviews and separation of duties not operating

control_description: Badge access to the wire room (9 people), operations center, and records room; ATM anti-skimming hardware
Paper shredding with certificates; drives from workstations and ATMs destroyed without serial-number certificates

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Branch firewalls allow no inbound services; payments workstations isolated; providers' DDoS protection; MSSP monitoring
evidence: Firewall rule review; provider SOC reports

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for all web services; private circuits to the core; loan documents with NPI sent as ordinary email attachments

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all endpoints and servers, monitored 24x7 by the MSSP; application allow-list on payments workstations

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Annual penetration test only; no authenticated scanning; admin console changes and cloud configuration not monitored

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSSP monitors EDR and firewall alerts; no alerts on beneficiary or limit changes; wire, admin console, and core logs not reviewed
MSSP triages security alerts 24x7; provider fraud alerts after hours wait until the next business day
BEC runbook approved 2026-08-31 (P08); plan update for 12 CFR Part 53 in progress; no tabletop since 2023
Providers recover their services; alternate wire procedure untested since 2023; bank backups not immutable or restore-tested
IT change log for endpoints and network; limit and threshold changes in the admin console made by email
Business continuity plan; BIA completed (P05); operations center and wire room share one building
gap: Single site for wires and operations

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Due diligence at selection; core processor SOC reports reviewed 2026-08-20 with CUEC mapping; other providers pending; contracts lack incident notice terms
gap: Remaining provider reviews and contract terms
